<!-- pr-reviewer: c255003dc74b305e6769cf3e8a10395324342b58 -->
**Needs changes before merge** - the behaviour is sound and the app-side pins hold, but the new UI take paths and the centre readout are unpinned.

### What looks good
- Opt-in is right: `PickKinds::ALL` is untouched; `feature_click::ask` opts in only the three-points draft (via `mode.points`, so Vertex mode only) and axis-by-two-points. Plain pick modes, plane row, axis-by-edge, fixture locate and the WCS role draft are unchanged. Flipping the axis-by-edge arm to `centres: true`, or dropping the points opt-in, turns `vertex_pick_tests::only_the_point_takers_that_read_a_centre_ask_for_centres` red.
- A centre is stored as the run (`FeatureSel::Chain`) and read through `circle_of_run`; straight and non-circular runs are refused by name (`centre_point`). No new unwrap/expect/panic, no project-format change, layering fine, provenance line on `centre.rs`.
- Centre visibility follows the edge (`arc_seen`, up to 8 samples); replacing it with `true` turns `a_hidden_round_edge_offers_its_centre_only_when_picking_through` red (Ortho and perspective), and Pick-through on offers it.
- MCP `lay_part_on_points` / `set_part_axes` go through `pick::points` / `pick::axis` -> `centre_point`, the same service; removing the `point()` Chain arm turns `three_points_read_a_round_edge_as_its_centre` and the MCP test red.
- Snap sort: rounding `perp` to 1e-6 mm (nm) then tie-breaking on eye distance is correct and deterministic (stable sort, equal keys keep candidate order). Reverting to the raw compare turns `a_round_edge_yields_its_centre_when_the_picker_opts_in` red. Note (not blocking): two values straddling a nm rounding boundary can still split; it removes float noise, not all near-ties.
- PV 55 against upstream main's 54; `Refs #692`; `Changelog:` line present; no snapshot PNGs, no CHANGELOG.md edit, no build.rs/deps/.github.

### Local results (merged with upstream/main, clean merge, no conflicts)
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (app lib + 19 suites incl. centre_pick, align, MCP align, fixture_locate; ui lib) | ok, 974 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

### Mutation check (each fix broken, tests re-run, then restored)
Red as claimed: sort nm rounding, `arc_seen`, `ask` opt-in, axis-by-edge opt-in, axis `take` straight-edge refusal (red via the existing `two_points_for_x_pick_vertices_and_flip_reverses_them`), `point()` Chain arm.
**Stayed green (unpinned):**
- `crates/ui/src/points_pick.rs:68-72`: the `FeatureSel::Chain(_) if no_centre.is_some()` refusal arm. With the guard disabled (`if false`) all 663 ui lib tests still pass: a straight edge would be drafted as a point and no test notices. The old test comment at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_points_tests.rs:102` ("A face or an edge sets no points") now only asserts the face half.
- `crates/ui/src/points_pick.rs` / `axis_pick.rs:take`: no test that a round-edge centre is accepted as a point in the draft.
- `crates/ui/src/axis_pick.rs:~267` (`centre` flag in `picks_text`): forcing `centre` to false changes nothing in the suite, so the centre readout is unpinned.
- `crates/app/src/pick/axis.rs` `pick_coords` centre fallback (`.or_else(... centre_of ...)`): removing it keeps `axis_align`, `centre_pick` and `mcp_align_axes` green.
- `crates/app/src/pick/points.rs:111-115` (the `centre_point(world, g)?` call in `datum_of`): removing it keeps `centre_pick` and `points_align` green (a straight edge is still refused later through `point()`), so the PR table's "guard removed: red" does not reproduce for that line; either pin it (assert the message names the edge/run it was given, not the generic one) or drop the redundant call.

### Requested before merge
1. Add a UI test for `points_pick::take`: a straight edge is refused with the "edge with no centre" status and nothing drafted; a circular edge's run is drafted as a point (also for a fourth one: refused). Re-add the edge half of the check at `setup_points_tests.rs:102`.
2. Pin the centre readout: `axis_pick::picks_text` for a centre pick (one point, not an edge) and `pick::pick_coords` returning the centre (an app test next to `centre_pick.rs` is enough).
3. Resolve the `datum_of` line above (pin it or remove it) so every behaviour claim in the PR table is backed by a red test.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- Hand check of the hover/rim highlight in the GUI is still owed, as the body says (hence `Refs`).
- Ties by nm rounding: fine as is.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 86407ed246c42196394de317a7f0af60d23f2168 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (delta review of c255003 -> 86407ed; the delta is test-only).

**What looks good**
- Each earlier ask is now pinned. I broke the code one change at a time on a trial merge with current main, and the named test went red each time:
  1. `points_pick::take` guard for a straight edge disabled -> `three_points_draft_a_round_edge_as_its_centre_and_refuse_a_straight_one` fails. The 4th-point limit raised -> same test fails. A round edge not drafted -> same test fails.
  2. `axis_pick::picks_text` centre readout disabled -> `an_axis_by_two_points_drafts_a_round_edge_and_reads_out_its_centre` fails. The `pick_coords` centre fallback removed -> `pick_coords_reports_a_round_edge_as_its_centre` fails.
  3. The `centre_point(world, g)?` line in `datum_of` (pick/points.rs:115) removed -> only `a_straight_edge_is_named_before_the_pick_count` fails.
- The author's claim holds. The per-pick loop in `datum_of` runs before the `[g1, g2, g3]` count check, so with fewer than 3 picks a straight edge gets the generic "pick three points - N picked" message without that line.
- `crates/ui/src/centre_pick_tests.rs` is `#[cfg(test)]`-gated in `lib.rs:73-74`. It carries a provenance line, and its `expect`/`unwrap_or_default` calls appear only in test code.
- File sizes are fine: the new tests are 139 and 330 lines, and the largest touched source file is 394 lines.

**Local results (merged with main, clean merge)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test centre_pick`: 8 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib centre_pick`: 2 passed. `--lib pick`: 78 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Snapshot PNGs: no change.

**Requested before merge**
- None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The earlier `needs-rework` came from this review thread; this delta resolves its asks.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
